title: Paruppusilli
text:
| Paruppusilli |  | 
|---|---|
| Place of origin | India | 
|---|---|
| Region or state | Tamil Nadu | 
| Main ingredients | Toor dal, bengalgram dal, red chillies, french beans or cluster beans | 
Paruppusilli (Tamil: பருப்புஉசிலி) is a traditional Tamil dish. It is made by cooking toor dal and bengal gram dal with red chillies and french beans/cluster beans/plantain flowers, and is flavored with asafoetida, curry leaves and mustard seeds. It is typically served with rice and Mor Kuzhambu during a meal.[1]
